messages:
jess_docs: Hi team  I'm opening a small docs PR to clarify Dedicated provisioning wording (autoscale semantics, eviction vs preemption) and to add compact examples (YAML + Terraform + tiny SDK snippets). PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1560

harry_platform: Thanks. Can you paste the minimal YAML and an SDK example here so I can sanity-check field names? Prefer snake_case in examples to match the REST API.

jess_docs: YAML draft (very small):
```yaml
name: team-reserved-pool
gpu: a100-40gb
autoscale:
  min_replicas: 1
  max_replicas: 5
  burst: 2
tenant_isolation: true
```

owen_infra: Terraform one-liner for migration (keeps it short):
```hcl
resource "redwood_dedicated_pool" "team" {
  name = "team-reserved-pool"
  tenant_isolation = true
  labels = { migrated_from = "legacy-team" }
}
```

natalie_prod: SLA wording: avoid absolutes. Suggest: "Reserved pools are prioritized for availability; preemption of lower-tier resources may occur under defined capacity emergencies. Reserved pools are not guaranteed to be hardware-dedicated unless explicitly contracted." Please link to the SLA matrix: https://confluence.redwood.ai/sla-matrix/v3

harry_platform: SDK snippets: tiny Python + Go drafts below. Python get-SLA meta (read-only):
```py
from redwood import DedicatedClient
c = DedicatedClient()
print(c.get_pool('team-reserved-pool')['sla'])
```
Go create (pseudo-minimal):
```go
c := redwood.NewClient()
_, err := c.CreatePool("team-reserved-pool", redwood.CreatePoolOpts{GPU: "a100-40gb", Autoscale: redwood.Autoscale{Min:1, Max:5, Burst:2}, TenantIsolation:true})
if err != nil { /* handle */ }
```

jess_docs: Good catches. I'll swap any `tenancy` references to `tenant_isolation` and add a short note: "min_replicas is a soft floor; under high global GPU pressure autoscaler may reduce below min temporarily."

owen_infra: Also add a troubleshooting bullet: NodeAffinity errors when requested SKU isn't available in region. Recommend `redwoodctl pool describe` before migrating.

ci-bot: docs-lint: passed for PR #1560  link-check OK.

natalie_prod: Include a one-line cost hint labeled "rough estimate" linking to pricing. Good to keep it visible but not prescriptive.

jess_docs: Will add cost hint, SLA sentence from Natalie, Terraform snippet, and the small SDK examples. Assigning reviewers @harry_platform and @owen_infra. Target merge: EOD Thu if no blockers. Thanks!
